skill.name: instagram-content-research
skill.description: Research Instagram content through SocialDataX keyword searches, bounded pagination, and evidence-based summaries for creators and brand teams.
skill.summary: Find Instagram content samples and organize traceable research observations using SocialDataX.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: All 30 static alerts are false positives involving Markdown formatting, documented service URLs, expected credential configuration, or readable multilingual text. A separate supply-chain risk exists because the example automatically runs the latest npm package without a pinned version. No evidence found of prompt injection or intentional credential exfiltration in the supplied files; external package behavior was not verified.

remediation.issue: The direct CLI example automatically executes an unpinned npm package.
remediation.suggestion: Replace @latest with a reviewed exact version and use a lockfile with integrity checks. Require user approval before installing or executing downloaded dependencies.

content.value_statement: Instagram research needs relevant samples and traceable evidence, not unsupported trend claims. This skill guides SocialDataX keyword searches and organizes returned content into focused observations.
actual_capabilities: Search Instagram posts by keyword through the SocialDataX CLI or its corresponding MCP tool.
Limit collection by page count or item count and continue searches with returned pagination tokens.
Organize returned samples using available titles, descriptions, authors, links, content identifiers, metrics, and publication times.
Separate visible evidence from interpretation and suggest focused follow-up research questions.
Retain partial results and resume with remaining collection limits when a valid continuation token is available.
limitations: Requires SocialDataX credentials, network access, and sufficient service balance; the direct CLI also requires Node.js and npm.
Only keyword search is documented; dedicated profile retrieval, complete account histories, and exhaustive search collection are not provided.
Does not log in, publish posts, like content, comment, or modify Instagram accounts.
External package behavior is not verified here; the documented CLI command executes an unpinned latest release.

use_cases.title: Explore Content Angles
use_cases.description: Collect keyword-based samples and identify evidence-supported angles for future posts.

use_cases.title: Compare Competitor Messaging
use_cases.description: Search brand-related keywords and compare themes across returned samples without assuming complete account coverage.

use_cases.title: Prepare an Editorial Research Brief
use_cases.description: Organize bounded search results into traceable observations and follow-up questions for planning discussions.

prompt_templates.title: Find Initial Samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Instagram for [keyword] using one page. Summarize relevant samples and preserve available authors, links, or content identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Content Direction
prompt_templates.prompt: Find up to 10 Instagram samples about [topic] for [audience]. Separate returned evidence from suggested content angles.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Brand-Related Samples
prompt_templates.prompt: Search [brand A] and [brand B] separately, with one page per query. Compare observed themes and cite available links without claiming complete coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Bounded Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic], stopping at three pages or 30 items. Preserve partial results and resume only with valid tokens and remaining limits. Separate evidence from interpretation.

output_examples.input: Find Instagram content angles for indoor gardening.
output: Illustrative format only; no live search results are represented.
Sample record: returned title or description, author, and available link or content identifier.
Observation: describe the visible subject and explain its relevance.
Follow-up: narrow the next query to the most relevant audience or setting.

output_examples.input: Continue a search after a partial response.
output: Illustrative recovery summary: retained samples remain available, but the collection is incomplete.
Continue only when a nonempty continuation token exists and collection limits remain.
Without a usable token, report the interruption rather than automatically restarting from the first page.

best_practices: Start with one page and explicit collection limits before expanding the research.
Preserve available source references and distinguish sample observations from broader conclusions.
Use a reviewed, pinned CLI version and obtain approval before installing dependencies; keep API keys out of prompts and reports.
anti_patterns: Treating keyword search samples as complete account coverage or proof of a platform-wide trend.
Automatically restarting partial searches, ignoring collection limits, or repeatedly retrying insufficient-balance errors.
Assuming read-only Instagram operations make locally executed third-party packages harmless.

faq.question: What inputs does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports keywords or topic directions. Brand and account names can be included as search terms, not dedicated profile lookup arguments.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and ensure service access. The direct CLI requires Node.js, npm, network access, and approval for dependency installation.

faq.question: Does it post or change my Instagram account?
faq.answer: The documented workflow only searches content. It does not log in, publish, like, comment, or modify accounts.

faq.question: Can it retrieve every matching post?
faq.answer: No. Search has no stable complete-result boundary and does not support an all-results option. Use page or item limits.

faq.question: What happens when a search returns partial results?
faq.answer: Keep the returned samples and error. Resume only with a nonempty continuation token and remaining limits; otherwise report the incomplete collection.

faq.question: Is the provided CLI command fully reviewed?
faq.answer: No. It runs the latest external npm package, whose implementation is not included. Pin and review dependencies before execution.
